description: Create polished, compile-tested Typst documents from curated kirklin templates and build them to PDF with per-page PNG previews. Use when the user wants to write, typeset, or compile a Typst document — especially an academic or research paper in NeurIPS/arXiv style (the neurips-paper template) — or says "make a Typst paper", "write a conference paper in Typst", "typeset this as a paper", "compile this .typ", or "turn this into a PDF paper". This is a template framework: pick a template under templates/, copy and customize it, then build with scripts/compile.sh (typst compile, per-page PNG previews). New document types are added as templates.
